name: EventPlanner
description: Orchestrates event planning: delegates to VenueAgent and CateringAgent.

skills.name: plan_event
skills.description: Plan an event given guest count and budget.

name: VenueAgent
description: Finds a suitable venue for a given guest count and budget.

skills.name: find_venue
skills.description: Return a venue proposal or refuse.

name: CateringAgent
description: Finds a suitable caterer within a remaining budget and venue constraints.

skills.name: find_caterer
skills.description: Return a caterer proposal or refuse.
